heroSection.title: Welcome to Baloch Heritage Canada
heroSection.subtitle: Celebrating our culture, connecting our community, and building a brighter future together.

aboutSection.title: Our Mission
aboutSection.content: The Baloch Cultural Society of Canada is dedicated to preserving, promoting, and celebrating the rich heritage of the Baloch people. We aim to foster a strong, supportive, and inclusive community for all generations of Baloch Canadians, while sharing our beautiful traditions with the diverse Canadian mosaic.

cultureCards.title: Traditional Textiles (Doch)
cultureCards.description: Explore the vibrant colors, intricate geometric patterns, and exquisite mirror work that define traditional Baloch embroidery, a craft passed down through generations.

cultureCards.title: Baloch Cuisine
cultureCards.description: Savor the rich flavors of Balochistan, from our world-famous Sajji (roasted lamb or chicken) to aromatic spiced rice and freshly baked traditional flatbreads.

cultureCards.title: Music & Instruments
cultureCards.description: Discover the soulful melodies of Baloch music, featuring traditional instruments like the Suroz and Danburo that carry the stories and poems of our ancestors.

historyTimeline.description: The first major wave of Baloch students and professionals begin arriving in Canada, settling primarily in Toronto and Vancouver.
The Baloch Cultural Society of Canada is officially established to help preserve cultural identity and support new immigrants.
The first national Baloch Cultural Festival is held in Ottawa, attracting attendees from across North America.
Opening of the dedicated Baloch Community Center, serving as a hub for language classes, cultural events, and youth programs.

resourcesSection.title: Balochi Language Classes
resourcesSection.description: Weekly classes for youth and adults to learn and practice speaking, reading, and writing Balochi.

resourcesSection.title: Newcomer Settlement Support
resourcesSection.description: Assistance for new Baloch immigrants, including help with housing, employment, and navigating Canadian systems.

resourcesSection.title: Youth Mentorship Program
resourcesSection.description: Connecting young Baloch Canadians with established professionals in various fields for guidance and support.
